utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I can start spreading the word to the neighbors right away if you’re still organizing the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll pass it along if I hear of anyone who could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Nell—I’ll keep you posted if anything changes. Hope we can help a few folks out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just wanted to confirm—are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re set on tools, so I’m mostly just making sure everyone’s there Saturday around 9 for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—so nothing else needed from me, just showing up Saturday around 9?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend you a wrench set and a screwdriver for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Since the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, can you still bring them by before then?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can drop them off before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? I can help work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning around 9 still works for me. I’ll let you know if the spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 9 should work for me too. Just let me know the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll help keep it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard a few small appliances and some bikes need fixing, but I’m still checking around quietly. I’ll let you know if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — small appliances and bikes, got it. Let me know if you hear anything else before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like you’re all set for the repair drive — Gus and Leo should cover the main needs. If I hear anything else while I’m out, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just let me know if anything changes, and I’ll be ready when it’s time to head out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly broken household items, small stuff folks can bring in. If you can fix things, that helps too — it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, Sunday at the community center — I’ll keep reminding folks and help keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. Appreciate you keeping it organized and spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and send you a quick update if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll plan for Sunday at the community center and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out in case the location shifts, but Sunday at the community center is the plan for now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — that should cover a lot. I’ll let you know if I hear of anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah. Please send me the pickup time and final item count when you have them so I can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do, Pia — I’ll send the pickup time and final item count as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — tape, nails, and a screwdriver would be a huge help. I’m just getting here late, so I really appreciate you all keeping the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Dane — we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so you’re all set. I’ll keep the list organized and make sure your supplies are counted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring what I can and make sure my supplies are counted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—I’m still trying to keep the repair drive moving along. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got tape and spare nails set aside, and I’ll check for a screwdriver too—just let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo—that sounds really helpful. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll bring some tape and a few spare screws for the repair drive. Let me know if there’s anything else you need covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll pass along anything else that comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — thanks, Tess. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we can use for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Saturday around 9 still works for me too. Thanks for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, it moved to Sunday at the community center. Are you still able to help, and is there anything else you need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sunday at the community center still works for me, and I’m able to help. I don’t need anything else right now, thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help spread the word quietly around the block. Saturday around 9, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, Saturday around 9 sounds right—thanks for helping spread the word quietly. I’m still a bit behind, but I’ll bring what I can for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just bring what you can, and I’ll keep things quiet and let the neighbors know. Saturday around 9, then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — if you can, bring tape, nails, or a screwdriver. I’m still keeping track of where everything’s headed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ve got the list now. I’ll bring a screwdriver set and wood glue for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll note screwdriver set and wood glue for the repair drive. I’m still tracking where everything’s going, so just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? I can help work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — late afternoon should work best, after school lets out. I’ll swing by then with the wrench set, screwdriver, gloves, and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work—I can make sure it fits around pickup time. Just let me know the exact spot and if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll bring some tape and a few spare screws for the repair drive, and I can remind Hana what still needs fixing too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Jules — that’ll really help keep the repair drive moving. I’ll pass it along and let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Glad to help — just send me anything else you hear, and I’ll keep Hana in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Eli — I’ve got the screwdriver covered, and the corner lot works for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that works for me. I’ll bring the wrench set and meet you at the corner lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then we’re set — I’ll bring the screwdriver and meet you at the corner lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly small household items that need fixing, and if you’ve got a repair skill, bring that too. It’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates I catch about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah. Appreciate you passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the pickup time and a clear count of what’s being loaded. Once we have that, I’ll feel better about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—just confirming, do you want me to check the pickup time and the load count for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please check both so we have Sunday at the community center sorted out. I’m just trying to keep the logistics clear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting underway—do they still need more volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we could still use more volunteers and a few supplies. I’ll keep nudging folks about the repair drive and remind them to bring any broken items or repair skills.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—I'll pass that along to folks I hear from. Let me know if you need me to keep an ear out for anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like we’re in good shape for the repair drive — thanks, everyone for helping keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep you posted if anything else turns up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Tess — appreciate you keeping an eye out, and let me know if anything comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo — start by checking the small fixes table, and thank you, Cleo; those supplies will be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll check the small fixes table and keep an eye on the spot. Thanks, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — if anything comes up, send people to the community center help table. Thanks again for pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Uli — I’m glad you’ll be there Sunday. I’ll keep telling the neighbors and let you know if anyone needs help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll be at the community center Sunday and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Uli — thanks for being there. I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know if anyone needs help.
